dataDisclosure: The bridge sends the text prompt or reference image you submit to the public three.ws Forge API over HTTPS and downloads the finished .glb. It sends a random per-install client handle for rate limiting. It reads no project files other than the image you choose to submit, and sends no telemetry.
releaseNotes: 0.1.0: first public release. Browse the catalog, generate a mesh from a text prompt or reference photos, poll the job, and import the result with the engine's own glTF importer, with collider, material and scale import settings.
tagline: Text or photo to a textured 3D model, imported with Interchange.
description: Generate a textured 3D model from a text prompt or reference photos with the free three.ws Forge pipeline, straight into the Unreal Editor. The plugin adds a Window > three.ws Forge Bridge dock with a prompt field, a quality tier and a Generate and import button. Downloads are imported through Unreal's own Interchange glTF pipeline, so there is no custom mesh parser. Import settings cover bounding-box collision, material import and scale. Includes a C++ client module usable from your own tools. Every call goes to the live public three.ws API.

submission.upload: Fab Publisher Portal > Create listing > Code Plugin. Upload one build per supported engine version, produced with: RunUAT BuildPlugin -Plugin=<path>/ThreeWsBridge.uplugin -Package=<out> -TargetPlatforms=Win64+Linux. The packaged source zip in dist/engine-stores/unreal is the reviewable source for the listing.
submission.media: Thumbnail 1920x1080 and 3 or more screenshots; icon 512x512 rendered at dist/engine-stores/unreal/artwork.
submission.note: Unreal Editor is not installed on the packaging machine, so the binary build is the step that runs on the owner's Unreal install.
